name: com.rowhousesoftware/kind-reply
title: Kind Reply
description: Check a reply to a Google review before you post it.

tools.name: check_reply
tools.description: Checks a drafted reply to a Google review for the things that get small businesses in trouble: promises the owner didn't make (refunds, discounts, free items, call backs, dates), arguing with or blaming the reviewer, names, numbers or links that aren't in the review or the business details, the reviewer's last name, stock phrases that make replies sound automatic, and at dental, medical and vet offices anything that confirms the person was a patient or mentions their care (a privacy law risk). Says which lines to change and whether the review should wait for the owner. Plain code.

review.description: The customer's review text, as it appears on Google. Empty if they left stars only.

business_type.description: The kind of business. dentist, medical and vet get the patient privacy checks.

reviewer_name.description: The reviewer's name as Google shows it.

business_phone.description: The business phone number, if the reply may give it.

sign_off.description: How the owner signs replies, like "Maria, owner".

owner_samples.description: A few replies the owner wrote themselves, so emoji or numbers they use aren't flagged.

tools.name: safe_reply
tools.description: Gives a short, safe reply written by our code from fixed lines: thanks for good reviews, a sorry and an invitation to call for bad ones. For dental, medical and vet offices it's the only reply shape that keeps patient details private. It passes every check in check_reply.

tools.name: pro_status
tools.description: Says what the paid Kind Reply plan adds on the website (replies in the owner's voice for pasted or forwarded reviews, a weekly summary), what it costs and where to start. Nothing is bought here.
